cards.title: Timber grid and external stair offer "a wink" to Centre Pompidou at its annexe in Massy
cards.extract: French architecture studio PCA-Stream has completed Centre Pompidou Francilien in Massy, a storage and exhibition space fronted by a gridded timber deck and external stair that echo the high-tech character of the iconic original Centre Pompidou in Paris. cards.title: jean couvreur transforms iconic train emergency hammers into bookends, wall hooks, and candlesticks
cards.extract: to celebrate the 45th anniversary of the TGV, designer jean couvreur composes new objects using iconic parts salvaged from the train. cards.title: Nuuk Airport / ZESO Architects
cards.extract: Nuuk Airport is both architecturally and functionally a response to the beautiful yet harsh Arctic Climate.
